tagline: One Apollo. One Firm. One Team.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net IRR is the key KPI because it measures the actual performance delivered to investors after fees, which is the primary driver of fundraising and reputation in asset management.
company_description: Apollo Global Management, Inc. is a private equity firm specializing in investments in credit, private equity, infrastructure, secondaries and real estate markets. The firm prefers to invest in private and public markets. The firm's private equity investments include traditional buyouts, recapitalization, distressed buyouts and debt investments in real estate, corporate partner buyouts, distressed asset, corporate carve-outs, middle market, growth, venture capital, turnaround, bridge, corporate restructuring, special situation, acquisition, and industry consolidation transactions. For credit strategies, the firm focuses to invest in multi-sector credit, semi-liquid credit, direct lending, first lien, unitranche, whole loans and private credit. The firm provides its services to endowment and sovereign wealth funds, as well as other institutional and individual investors. It manages client focused portfolios. The firm launches and manages hedge funds for its clients. It also manages real estate funds and private equity funds for its clients. kpis.name: Net Internal Rate of Return
kpis.explanation: Annualized net return to investors in Apollo funds after fees.
kpis.description: Net IRR is the primary performance metric for private equity funds. It reflects Apollo's ability to generate value for its LPs.
kpis.signal: Strong performance on ADIP I (2020) fund at 18%, up versus prior periods.

kpis.name: Gross Internal Rate of Return
kpis.explanation: Annualized return before deduction of fees and costs.
kpis.description: Gross IRR shows the gross performance of investments, independent of fees.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in Gross IRR on ADIP I (2020) to 21%, indicating strong value creation.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed by Apollo on behalf of its clients.
kpis.description: AUM is a key indicator of the size and growth trajectory of the firm.
kpis.signal: Steady AUM growth, reflecting investor confidence.

kpis.name: Realized Value
kpis.explanation: Value of assets sold or exited from portfolios.
kpis.description: Realized value indicates Apollo's ability to monetize its investments.
kpis.signal: Increase in value realization, signaling successful asset exits.

kpis.name: Unrealized Value
kpis.explanation: Current value of assets still held in portfolios.
kpis.description: Unrealized value shows the future exit potential of portfolio assets.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth in unrealized value, reflecting stable valuations.

kpis.name: Invested Capital
kpis.explanation: Total amount deployed into investments by Apollo funds.
kpis.description: Invested capital reflects the firm's investment deployment activity.
kpis.signal: Ongoing capital deployment, indicating sustained investment activity.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last four reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $32.049 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last four reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $3.492 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Public Equity Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Estimated impact of a 10% decline in public equity markets on pre-tax income.
kpis.description: Athene, Apollo's subsidiary, is exposed to public markets through its investments.
kpis.signal: Increased sensitivity to public equity markets in 2025.

kpis.name: Interest Rate Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Estimated impact of a 100 basis point rise in interest rates on pre-tax income.
kpis.description: Apollo's fixed income assets at Athene are sensitive to interest rate fluctuations.
kpis.signal: Significant expected impact, though not quantified in the report.

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total dividends paid per share during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Five-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance ex-div dates.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends and buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source: yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income distributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the firm's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: Five-year history (2020-2024). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).
